```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The kableExtra package is required to format the analysis QC report.")
}

table1_qc_file <- params$table1_qc_file
model_qc_file <- params$model_qc_file

options(knitr.kable.NA = "—")

validate_file_parameter <- function(path, parameter_name) {
  if (
    !is.character(path) ||
    length(path) != 1L ||
    is.na(path) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(path))
  ) {
    stop("The ", parameter_name, " parameter must contain one nonempty character file path.")
  }

  path <- path.expand(path)

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(parameter_name, " file not found: ", path)
  }

  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    stop(parameter_name, " identifies a directory rather than a file: ", path)
  }

  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

table1_qc_file <- validate_file_parameter(
  path = table1_qc_file,
  parameter_name = "table1_qc_file"
)

model_qc_file <- validate_file_parameter(
  path = model_qc_file,
  parameter_name = "model_qc_file"
)

table1_qc <- readRDS(table1_qc_file)
model_qc <- readRDS(model_qc_file)

if (!is.list(table1_qc)) {
  stop("The Table 1 QC RDS must contain a list.")
}

if (!is.list(model_qc)) {
  stop("The model QC RDS must contain a list.")
}

get_diagnostic_site <- function(diagnostics, label) {
  if (!is.list(diagnostics$metadata)) {
    stop(label, " diagnostic metadata must be a list.")
  }

  site <- diagnostics$metadata$site

  if (
    !is.character(site) ||
    length(site) != 1L ||
    is.na(site) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(site))
  ) {
    stop(label, " diagnostic metadata must contain one nonempty character site label.")
  }

  site
}

table1_site <- get_diagnostic_site(table1_qc, "Table 1")
model_site <- get_diagnostic_site(model_qc, "Model")

if (!identical(table1_site, model_site)) {
  stop("Table 1 and model diagnostic site labels disagree: ", table1_site, " versus ", model_site, ".")
}

report_site <- params$site_name

if (is.null(report_site)) {
  report_site <- model_site
} else {
  if (
    !is.character(report_site) ||
    length(report_site) != 1L ||
    is.na(report_site) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(report_site))
  ) {
    stop("The site_name parameter must be null or one nonempty character site label.")
  }

  if (!identical(report_site, model_site)) {
    stop("Report site_name does not match the saved diagnostics: ", report_site, " versus ", model_site, ".")
  }
}

required_table1_sections <- c(
  "metadata", "upstream_input_contract", "required_variables", "pbwpfvc_eligibility",
  "table1_cohort", "terciles", "respiratory_anchor_provenance", "selected_tidal_volume_cleaning",
  "categorical_variables", "mortality", "continuous_variables", "checks"
)

required_model_sections <- c(
  "metadata", "adjustment_covariates", "exposures", "mortality", "continuous_outcomes",
  "vfd_competing_risks", "aic_comparison", "survival", "demographic_bias", "pfvc_vs_pbw",
  "unified_results", "residual_confounding", "conditional_bias", "site_qc_figures", "checks"
)

missing_table1_sections <- setdiff(required_table1_sections, names(table1_qc))
missing_model_sections <- setdiff(required_model_sections, names(model_qc))

if (length(missing_table1_sections) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The Table 1 QC RDS is missing required section(s): ",
    paste(missing_table1_sections, collapse = ", "),
    ". Rerun Script 04 from the beginning."
  )
}

if (length(missing_model_sections) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The model QC RDS is missing required section(s): ",
    paste(missing_model_sections, collapse = ", "),
    ". Rerun Script 04 from the beginning."
  )
}

find_missing_report_components <- function(required, object, prefix) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(object))

  if (length(missing) == 0L) {
    return(character())
  }

  paste0(prefix, missing)
}

missing_report_components <- c(
  find_missing_report_components(
    c("policy", "thresholds", "upstream_retention", "checks"),
    table1_qc$selected_tidal_volume_cleaning,
    "selected_tidal_volume_cleaning$"
  ),
  find_missing_report_components(
    c("sample_summary", "method_summary", "logrank_tests", "checks"),
    model_qc$survival$kaplan_meier,
    "survival$kaplan_meier$"
  )
)

if (length(missing_report_components) > 0L) {
  stop("The analysis report is missing required diagnostic components: ", paste(missing_report_components, collapse = ", "))
}

show_table <- function(
  x,
  digits = 2,
  empty_text = "No records to display.",
  landscape = FALSE,
  character_width = "3.2cm",
  landscape_section = FALSE,
  first_column_width_cm = NULL
) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output("*Diagnostic not available.*\n\n"))
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  }

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(paste0("*", empty_text, "*\n\n")))
  }

  for (flag in list(landscape, landscape_section)) {
    if (!is.logical(flag) || length(flag) != 1L || is.na(flag)) {
      stop("Landscape arguments must be TRUE or FALSE.")
    }
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("kableExtra is required for diagnostic-report table formatting.")
  }

  x <- tibble::as_tibble(x)

  # Display labels only; underlying names and values are unchanged.
  heading_labels <- names(x) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      c(
        "hospitalizations" = "hosp",
        "hospitalization" = "hosp",
        "measurements" = "values",
        "measurement" = "value",
        "percentage" = "pct",
        "percent" = "pct",
        "minimum" = "min",
        "maximum" = "max"
      )
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ")

  latex_output <- knitr::is_latex_output()
  long_table <- nrow(x) > 30L
  landscape_table <- latex_output && (landscape || landscape_section)

  table_output <- knitr::kable(
    x,
    col.names = heading_labels,
    digits = digits,
    booktabs = latex_output,
    longtable = latex_output && long_table,
    escape = TRUE
  )

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    table_output <- table_output %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "responsive"),
        full_width = FALSE,
        position = "left",
        font_size = 10
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%")
  }

  if (latex_output) {
    width_budget_cm <- if (landscape_table) 20 else 13

    table_output <- table_output %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = if (long_table) "repeat_header" else "hold_position",
        font_size = if (landscape_table || ncol(x) > 7L) 7 else 8,
        position = "left"
      )

    column_weights <- vapply(
      x,
      function(column) {
        if (is.character(column) || is.factor(column)) 2 else 1
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    if (
      !is.character(character_width) ||
      length(character_width) != 1L ||
      is.na(character_width) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?cm$", character_width)
    ) {
      stop("character_width must be a positive width expressed in cm.")
    }

    requested_character_width <- as.numeric(sub("cm$", "", character_width))
    if (!is.finite(requested_character_width) || requested_character_width <= 0) {
      stop("character_width must be positive.")
    }

    if (is.null(first_column_width_cm)) {
      first_label <- tolower(trimws(heading_labels[[1L]]))
      first_is_text <- is.character(x[[1L]]) || is.factor(x[[1L]])

      first_column_width_cm <- if (
        grepl("filter step|exclusion reason|interpretation", first_label)
      ) {
        4.5
      } else if (grepl("^device$|device category", first_label)) {
        2.5
      } else if (!first_is_text) {
        1.8
      } else {
        requested_character_width
      }
    }

    if (
      !is.numeric(first_column_width_cm) ||
      length(first_column_width_cm) != 1L ||
      is.na(first_column_width_cm) ||
      !is.finite(first_column_width_cm) ||
      first_column_width_cm <= 0 ||
      first_column_width_cm >= width_budget_cm
    ) {
      stop("first_column_width_cm must be positive and below the table budget.")
    }

    if (ncol(x) == 1L) {
      column_widths_cm <- first_column_width_cm
    } else {
      remaining_weights <- column_weights[-1L]
      column_widths_cm <- c(
        first_column_width_cm,
        (width_budget_cm - first_column_width_cm) *
          remaining_weights / sum(remaining_weights)
      )
    }

    for (column_number in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
      table_output <- kableExtra::column_spec(
        table_output,
        column = column_number,
        width = paste0(
          formatC(
            column_widths_cm[[column_number]],
            format = "f",
            digits = 2
          ),
          "cm"
        )
      )
    }

    if (landscape_table && !landscape_section) {
      table_output <- kableExtra::landscape(table_output)
    }
  }

  table_output
}

show_note <- function(text) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(text, "\n\n"))
}

validate_report_checks <- function(checks) {
  if (!is.list(checks) || length(checks) == 0L) {
    stop("Report integrity checks must be a nonempty list.")
  }

  check_names <- names(checks)

  if (
    is.null(check_names) ||
    anyNA(check_names) ||
    any(!nzchar(trimws(check_names))) ||
    anyDuplicated(check_names)
  ) {
    stop("Report integrity checks must have unique, nonempty names.")
  }

  valid_shapes <- vapply(
    checks,
    function(value) is.logical(value) && length(value) == 1L,
    logical(1)
  )

  if (!all(valid_shapes)) {
    stop(
      "Malformed report integrity check(s): ",
      paste(check_names[!valid_shapes], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Missing logical results are retained as REVIEW, never treated as PASS.
  vapply(checks, function(value) value[[1]], logical(1))
}

checks_to_table <- function(checks) {
  check_values <- validate_report_checks(checks)

  tibble(
    check = names(check_values),
    passed = unname(check_values)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      check = str_replace_all(check, "_", " ") %>%
        str_to_sentence(),
      status = if_else(passed %in% TRUE, "PASS", "REVIEW")
    ) %>%
    select(check, status)
}

summarize_checks <- function(checks, area) {
  check_values <- validate_report_checks(checks)

  tibble(
    QC_area = area,
    n_checks = length(check_values),
    n_passed = sum(check_values %in% TRUE),
    n_review = sum(!(check_values %in% TRUE)),
    status = if_else(all(check_values %in% TRUE), "PASS", "REVIEW")
  )
}

table1_check_summary <- summarize_checks(table1_qc$checks, "Table 1")
model_check_summary <- summarize_checks(model_qc$checks, "Models and analysis outputs")

overall_qc_status <- if (
  table1_check_summary$status == "PASS" &&
    model_check_summary$status == "PASS"
) {
  "PASS"
} else {
  "REVIEW"
}
```

## Respiratory-anchor provenance

Cohort inclusion does not require procedure-code 31500 presence. Respiratory anchors are documented transitions
from a known state other than invasive to invasive support, or the first documented invasive timestamp in an ICU
for a hospitalization whose initial known support state is invasive.

The table below classifies each Table 1 patient's selected index timepoint by anchor method and
hospitalization-level procedure evidence.

```{r}
show_table(table1_qc$respiratory_anchor_provenance)
```

## Selected analytic tidal-volume cleaning

Script 01 uses positive tidal volume to establish one-hour eligibility. Script 03 applies source-specific
thresholds to the originally selected analytic volume. Invalidated values become missing without substituting
another source, and the completeness gate determines subsequent retention.

## Driving-pressure provenance

```{r}
show_table(model_qc$continuous_outcomes$driving_pressure_provenance$source_summary)
```

The driving-pressure estimate follows the implemented hierarchy: observed plateau pressure minus set PEEP,
followed by observed or set peak inspiratory pressure (PIP) minus set PEEP.
Nonpositive candidate values are invalidated upstream.

Plateau-derived values represent static driving-pressure estimates. PIP-derived fallback values are not
equivalent to plateau-derived static driving pressure. Interpret the mechanics analyses alongside the
reported source distribution.

```{=latex}
\BeginDiagnosticLandscape
```

# Automated review items

```{r}
#| results: asis

review_items <- character()

if (
  !is.null(model_qc$mortality$events_per_parameter_below_10) &&
    any(model_qc$mortality$events_per_parameter_below_10$below_10)
) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "Primary mortality models have fewer than 10 events per fitted non-intercept parameter."
  )
}

if (
  !is.null(model_qc$survival$events_per_coefficient_below_10) &&
    any(model_qc$survival$events_per_coefficient_below_10$below_10)
) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "Primary Cox models have fewer than 10 events per fitted coefficient."
  )
}

continuous_flags <- model_qc$continuous_outcomes$diagnostic_summary

if (!is.null(continuous_flags) && any(continuous_flags$n_heteroskedastic > 0L)) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "Heteroskedasticity was identified in one or more continuous-outcome models; HC3 inference was used."
  )
}

if (!is.null(continuous_flags) && any(continuous_flags$n_reset_flagged > 0L)) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "RESET diagnostics flagged possible functional-form misspecification in one or more continuous-outcome models."
  )
}

if (!is.null(continuous_flags) && any(continuous_flags$n_with_large_residuals > 0L)) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "Large externally studentized residuals were identified in one or more continuous-outcome models."
  )
}

pfvc_flags <- model_qc$pfvc_vs_pbw$diagnostic_flags

if (!is.null(pfvc_flags) && isTRUE(pfvc_flags$specification_test[[1]])) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "The primary PFVC-versus-PBW model was flagged by the RESET specification test."
  )
}

if (
  !is.null(model_qc$conditional_bias$variable_summary) &&
    any(model_qc$conditional_bias$variable_summary$pct_missing >= 40, na.rm = TRUE)
) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "Respiratory-mechanics conditional-bias plots have substantial source-variable missingness and sparse cells."
  )
}

if (length(review_items) == 0L) {
  cat("No automated analytical review items were identified.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("- ", unique(review_items)), sep = "\n")
}
```
